quotes.name: Tara Ellison
quotes.quote: To be honest, I've just been doing my job as a journalist, covering local news and events. Recently, a manager at Bay Tribune asked me to redo some work that had already been approved, which was a bit frustrating. I've been noticing the usual things in Rockridge, like the busy aisles at Canopy Market. I don't feel like I've been working on anything particularly remarkable or influential lately.
